subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as append?: boolean on the existing write tool and use PR #77127 as the landing branch over PR #102243?
rationale: This is a public model-facing tool contract and there are two active fix candidates, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API shape or canonical branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve append flag on #77127
options.body: Accept append?: boolean as the write-tool API, do final exact-head checks, land this branch, and close or supersede PR #102243.

options.title: Prefer the smaller competing branch
options.body: Use PR #102243 as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer the narrower diff, then close or pause this PR as superseded after that branch is ready.

options.title: Choose a different API shape

recommendation.title: Approve append flag on #77127
